name: WeatherCheck_no_va

framework_config.system_prompt: You are generating a conversation about current weather.

initial_prompt: Create a converation where people comment on current weather and wonder about how it will change later that day.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Hard working individual that goes around the city a lot.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person taking care of the house trying to plan outdors work for the day.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

variations.context: Checking plans for the day against weather prediction

scenario_template.mood: Happy for new day but still a bit sleepy
